name: SentinelOne — Agents
description: Pull endpoint inventory from SentinelOne (agent status, OS, site/group, network interfaces, domain, last activity)

steps.instruction: Log into the SentinelOne Management Console
Navigate to Settings > Users > your user, or Settings > Service Users to create a dedicated API user
Click Actions > Generate API Token. Copy the token value.

validation_request.error_message: Could not authenticate with SentinelOne. Check the API token and console URL.

transform.expr: (record.get('computerName', '') + '.' + str(value)) if value and value != 'WORKGROUP' else record.get('computerName', '')

{'ip': ((record.get('networkInterfaces') or [{}])[0].get('inet') or [''])[0], 'hostname': record.get('computerName', ''), 'fqdn': record.get('computerName', '') + ('.' + str(record.get('domain', '')) if record.get('domain') and record.get('domain') != 'WORKGROUP' else ''), 'device_id': value, 'display_name': record.get('computerName') or value}

{'agent_version': record.get('agentVersion', ''), 'is_active': record.get('isActive', False), 'is_decommissioned': record.get('isDecommissioned', False), 'is_up_to_date': record.get('isUpToDate', False), 'infected': record.get('infected', False), 'scan_status': record.get('scanStatus', ''), 'site_id': record.get('siteId', ''), 'site_name': record.get('siteName', ''), 'group_id': record.get('groupId', ''), 'group_name': record.get('groupName', ''), 'account_id': record.get('accountId', ''), 'account_name': record.get('accountName', ''), 'machine_type': record.get('machineType', ''), 'os_type': record.get('osType', ''), 'os_arch': record.get('osArch', ''), 'model_name': record.get('modelName', ''), 'serial_number': record.get('serialNumber', ''), 'cpu_count': record.get('cpuCount', ''), 'total_memory': record.get('totalMemory', ''), 'domain': record.get('domain', ''), 'active_threats': record.get('activeThreats', 0), 'external_ip': record.get('externalIp', ''), 'network_status': record.get('networkStatus', ''), 'tags': [(t or {}).get('key', '') for t in (record.get('tags') or {}).get('sentinelone', []) if isinstance(t, dict)] if isinstance(record.get('tags'), dict) else []}
